items.t: Said the new 12-week abortion bill is a compromise after the initial six-week ban did not go through.
items.q: Nebraska Sen. Ben Hansen claims the new bill is a compromise after the initial six-week ban did not go through.

items.t: Proposed an abortion measure with exceptions for rape, incest and the life of the mother but no exception for fatal fetal anomalies.
items.q: While Hansen's measure offers exceptions for rape, incest and the life of the mother, it does not include an exception for fatal fetal anomalies, as Riepe's bill did.

record.t: Served as Chairman of the Business & Labor Committee in a new role.
record.q: As I transitioned into my new role this year as the Chairman of the Business & Labor Committee, my staff and I were met with significant challenges ranging from unemployment questions to workman's compensation.

record.t: Served on the Agriculture Committee and the Health and Human Services Committee.
record.q: On both the Agriculture Committee and the Health and Human Services Committee, our decisions were met with much anticipation following a tumultuous year in 2020.

record.t: Introduced ten bills in the session, almost half of which passed.
record.q: Of the ten bills I introduced, almost half of them passed. These bills addressed issues that include dealing with taxes, healthcare, 2nd amendment rights, and drug bills.
